questions.question: What did God do so Israel could escape across the Red Sea?
options: Divided the sea so they crossed on dry ground
Raised a bridge of stone across the water
Calmed a great storm so they could sail
Sent many boats to carry them all to the far shore
questions.answer: Divided the sea so they crossed on dry ground

questions.question: What happened to Pharaoh's army that pursued Israel into the sea?
options: The waters returned and drowned them
Fire from heaven consumed their chariots
They turned back and fled to Egypt
They surrendered and were taken captive
questions.answer: The waters returned and drowned them
